mission.name: Imazu 04 -- crossing from port
mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 4, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 crosses from port (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course/speed as stand-on for the target(s) crossing from port, only acting under Rule 17(b) if the other vessel clearly fails to act.
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
